archetype_reasoning: The user explicitly requested a 'Futuristic, Minimalist, Premium' design with 'neon green, blue, and black' colors. Archetype 7 perfectly aligns with this aesthetic, providing a deep space void background with electric cyan and neon green accents to convey an advanced, AI-driven experience.

layout_and_surfaces.card_style: Neumorphic glass blend. Backgrounds should be very dark gray (#121212) with a 1px subtle border (rgba(255,255,255,0.05)). Active states should feature a neon green or blue 1px border with a soft drop shadow (glow) effect.
layout_and_surfaces.input_style: Minimalist. Floating labels or simple placeholders. Underline focus or fully rounded borders with 1px neon border on focus. Background #1A1A1A.
layout_and_surfaces.button_primary: Solid neon green (#00FF66) with deep black text (#000000). Pill-shaped, bold text. Soft green glow on press.
layout_and_surfaces.button_secondary: Transparent background with 1px electric blue (#00E5FF) border and electric blue text. Pill-shaped.

animations.splash_intro: Epic scaling and fade-in. The 'AI CRAZY' logo should scale up from 0.8 to 1 with a slight bounce, while neon glows pulse in the background. 'Powered by AlexSarango' fades in from bottom after 1 second.
animations.page_transition: Fade and slight slide-up (translateY: 20 -> 0) to feel snappy and modern.
animations.buttons: Scale down to 0.95 on press-in using Reanimated, scale back to 1 on release.
animations.chat_bubbles: Slide in from bottom and fade in. Staggered effect for lists.

components.chat_bubble_user: Right-aligned, #1A1A1A background, rounded corners (except bottom-right), white text. 1px solid #333 border.
components.chat_bubble_ai: Left-aligned, fully black (#000000) background, rounded corners (except bottom-left), white text. 1px solid #00E5FF (electric blue) with subtle inner glow.
components.premium_card: Deep gradient background (black to dark blue), with glowing #00FF66 borders. Use the 'premium_bg' image as a subtle absolute positioned background layer.
components.style_selector_pill: Horizontal ScrollView of chips. Inactive: #1A1A1A background. Active: #00FF66 background, black text.

splash_bg.description: Futuristic deep black background with glowing light streaks. Use for Splash screen.

ai_avatar.description: Glowing 3D AI core icon. Use for the AI profile picture in chat and main intro logo.

premium_bg.description: Abstract dark metallic surface. Use as a background for the Premium Subscription upgrade screen.

cyber_city_bg.description: Futuristic city neon lights. Good for the AI 'Image Generation' category card background.

abstract_blue.description: Intricate blue abstract pattern. Use for the File Analysis / Content Creator card.

implementation_instructions.styling: Use StyleSheet or NativeWind (Tailwind for Expo) if configured. Adhere strictly to the black/neon color palette.
implementation_instructions.testing_ids: Ensure all TouchableOpacity, TextInput, and Button components have a 'testID' (React Native equivalent of data-testid) in kebab-case, e.g., testID='login-submit-button'.
implementation_instructions.navigation: Use React Navigation. Ensure transition animations are smooth. Hide header on Splash, Login, and Auth screens.
implementation_instructions.icons: Use @expo/vector-icons (Ionicons or Feather). Preferred stroke icons over filled to match the minimalist futuristic vibe.
